standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the row and column computations into the identification of the cohomology.

core_obligations: Form the double complex Hom_A(P_bullet, I_bullet) (proof lines 2927-2930).
Compute the row cohomology and the column cohomology (proof lines 2931-2933).
Degenerate the two spectral sequences to identify the cohomology with Pext (proof lines 2933-2936).
difficulty_reason: The lemma records three facts about Pext: vanishing in positive degrees when N is pure injective, the same when M is pure projective (in particular finitely presented), and the identification of Pext^i with the cohomology of Hom_A(P_bullet, N) for a pure projective resolution (statement lines 2913-2924). Only (3) is proved and it is done with a displayed double complex A^{bullet,bullet} = Hom_A(P_bullet, I^bullet): the proof notes that each row is exact except in degree zero where the cohomology is Hom_A(M, I^q) and each column is exact except in degree zero where the cohomology is Hom_A(P_p, N), so both associated spectral sequences degenerate and give the identification (proof lines 2926-2936). The level is H3: the double complex and the two degeneration statements are written out, and the vanishing statements follow from the resolution described in the same paragraph.
